title: Skill frontmatter
description: Contract for the YAML frontmatter of every skills/<name>/SKILL.md. The top level is exactly the Agent Skills specification (https://agentskills.io/specification), whose reference validator rejects unknown top-level fields. Everything specific to this package lives under `metadata` as string values, namespaced `targetbay.*`.

name.description: Stable skill identifier. Must equal the containing directory name and be unique across the package.

description.description: Trigger description in 'Use when ...' form. This is what an agent host matches against user intent, so it must describe the situation, not the implementation.

license.description: Spec field. Constant for this package.

compatibility.description: Spec field. Optional; only set it if a skill gains a genuine environment requirement.

allowed-tools.description: Spec field, experimental. Unused by this package: skills declare abstract capabilities in `metadata.targetbay.requires`, not host tool names.

metadata.description: Spec field: a map of string keys to string values. Lists are comma-space separated because the spec permits no other type here.

targetbay.display_name.description: Human-readable name used in documentation and indexes.

targetbay.version.description: Semantic version of this skill, independent of the package VERSION.

targetbay.requires.description: Abstract product capability identifiers this skill needs, comma-separated. Every entry must exist in the plugin's capabilities.yaml.

targetbay.composes.description: Other skills this skill delegates to, comma-separated. Must name existing skills; the composition graph must stay acyclic. Omitted when the skill composes nothing.

targetbay.risk_level.description: Highest risk class this skill can reach. See docs/architecture.md.

targetbay.execution_mode.description: How far the skill is permitted to proceed without a human decision.

targetbay.status.description: foundation = contract established, workflow not production-hardened. stable = production-ready.

targetbay.deprecated_by.description: Name of the superseding skill. Required reading when status is deprecated.
